newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Moody's ratings show Portugal's progress-official.
newsitem.headline: Moody's ratings show Portugal's progress-official.

text.p: A boost in foreign currency rating for Portugal by Moody's Investors Service is a reflection of sustained progress in the economy and policies of financial stability, a senior official said.

"This action of Moody's corresponds to the recognition of sustained progress that the Portuguese economy has shown and the firmness of financial policies," Vitor Bento, president of the Institute for Public Credit Management, told Reuters.

Moody's has raised Portugal's sovereign ceiling for foreign currency debt and bank deposits from A1 to Aa3. As a consequence, all foreign currency-denominated bonds and notes issued by the Republic of Portugal have been upgraded from A1 to Aa3.
